# Oh My OpenCode

Oh My OpenCode is a multi-model AI agent orchestration harness that transforms OpenCode into a coordinated development team. It breaks free from single-model limitations by orchestrating specialized AI agents across providers—Claude for orchestration, GPT for deep reasoning, Gemini for frontend tasks, and fast models for quick operations—all working together automatically. The system intelligently routes tasks based on intent classification, enabling parallel execution of background agents while maintaining lean context windows.

The plugin provides batteries-included functionality with 11 specialized agents (Sisyphus, Hephaestus, Prometheus, Oracle, Atlas, and more), hash-anchored editing that eliminates stale-line errors, LSP/AST tools for IDE-level precision, skill-embedded MCPs for domain-specific workflows, and discipline enforcement mechanisms that ensure tasks are completed. Installation is as simple as running `bunx oh-my-opencode install`, and getting started requires just typing `ultrawork` to let the agents figure out everything automatically.

## Installation

### Install via CLI

```bash
# Using Bun (recommended)
bunx oh-my-opencode install --no-tui --claude=yes --openai=yes --gemini=yes --copilot=no

# Using npx
npx oh-my-opencode install --no-tui --claude=yes --gemini=no --copilot=no

# Claude Max20 mode (20x usage)
bunx oh-my-opencode install --no-tui --claude=max20 --openai=yes --gemini=yes

# GitHub Copilot only
bunx oh-my-opencode install --no-tui --claude=no --gemini=no --copilot=yes

# Z.ai Coding Plan for Librarian agent
bunx oh-my-opencode install --no-tui --claude=yes --zai-coding-plan=yes
```

### Verify Installation

```bash
# Check OpenCode version (should be 1.0.150+)
opencode --version

# Verify plugin is registered
cat ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json | grep oh-my-opencode
# Expected: "plugin": ["oh-my-opencode"]

# Run doctor for diagnostics
bunx oh-my-opencode doctor --verbose
```

## Configuration

### Basic Configuration File

Configuration goes in `.opencode/oh-my-opencode.jsonc` (project) or `~/.config/opencode/oh-my-opencode.jsonc` (user). JSONC supports comments and trailing commas.

```jsonc
{
  "$schema": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-opencode/dev/assets/oh-my-opencode.schema.json",

  // Main orchestrator: Claude Opus or Kimi K2.5 work best
  "agents": {
    "sisyphus": {
      "model": "kimi-for-coding/k2p5",
      "ultrawork": { "model": "anthropic/claude-opus-4-6", "variant": "max" }
    },
    "librarian": { "model": "zai-coding-plan/glm-4.7" },
    "explore": { "model": "github-copilot/grok-code-fast-1" },
    "oracle": { "model": "openai/gpt-5.2", "variant": "high" },
    "prometheus": { "prompt_append": "Leverage deep & quick agents heavily, always in parallel." }
  },

  // Category-based task delegation
  "categories": {
    "quick": { "model": "opencode/gpt-5-nano" },
    "unspecified-low": { "model": "kimi-for-coding/k2p5" },
    "unspecified-high": { "model": "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6", "variant": "max" },
    "visual-engineering": { "model": "google/gemini-3-pro", "variant": "high" },
    "writing": { "model": "kimi-for-coding/k2p5" }
  },

  // Background task concurrency limits
  "background_task": {
    "providerConcurrency": { "anthropic": 3, "openai": 3, "opencode": 10 },
    "modelConcurrency": { "anthropic/claude-opus-4-6": 2, "opencode/gpt-5-nano": 20 }
  },

  "experimental": { "aggressive_truncation": true, "task_system": true },
  "tmux": { "enabled": false }
}
```

### Agent Override Configuration

```jsonc
{
  "agents": {
    "explore": {
      "model": "anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5",
      "temperature": 0.5,
      "permission": {
        "edit": "deny",
        "bash": "ask",
        "webfetch": "allow"
      }
    },
    "oracle": {
      "thinking": { "type": "enabled", "budgetTokens": 200000 }
    },
    "multimodal-looker": { "disable": true }
  },
  "disabled_agents": ["oracle", "multimodal-looker"]
}
```

### Runtime Fallback Configuration

```jsonc
{
  "runtime_fallback": {
    "enabled": true,
    "retry_on_errors": [400, 429, 503, 529],
    "max_fallback_attempts": 3,
    "cooldown_seconds": 60,
    "timeout_seconds": 30,
    "notify_on_fallback": true
  },
  "agents": {
    "sisyphus": {
      "model": "anthropic/claude-opus-4-6",
      "fallback_models": ["openai/gpt-5.2", "google/gemini-3-pro"]
    }
  }
}
```

## Working Modes

### Ultrawork Mode

The simplest way to use Oh My OpenCode—just type `ultrawork` or `ulw` and the system handles everything automatically.

```
# In your OpenCode session, simply type:
ultrawork Build a REST API with user authentication

# Or use the shorthand:
ulw Add dark mode toggle to the settings page

# The agent will:
# 1. Explore your codebase
# 2. Research patterns
# 3. Implement the feature
# 4. Verify with diagnostics
# 5. Keep working until done
```

### Prometheus Planning Mode

Press **Tab** to enter interview-based planning mode, then execute with `/start-work`.

```
# Press Tab to enter Prometheus mode, then describe your task:
I need to refactor the payment module to support multiple payment providers

# Prometheus will ask clarifying questions like:
# - Which payment providers need to be supported?
# - Should existing tests be preserved?
# - What's the error handling strategy?

# After planning is complete, execute:
/start-work

# Atlas takes over and distributes tasks to specialized subagents
```

## Agents

### Invoking Built-in Agents

```
# Consult Oracle for architecture decisions
Ask @oracle to review this design and propose an architecture for the notification system

# Use Librarian for documentation lookup
Ask @librarian how rate limiting is implemented in express-rate-limit

# Fast codebase exploration with Explore
Ask @explore for all authentication middleware files

# Invoke Hephaestus for deep autonomous work
@hephaestus Investigate and fix the memory leak in the WebSocket handler
```

### Background Agent Execution

```typescript
// Launch agent in background and continue working
task(
  subagent_type="explore",
  load_skills=[],
  prompt="Find all authentication implementations in the codebase",
  run_in_background=true
)

// Continue with other work...
// System notifies when background task completes

// Retrieve results when needed
background_output(task_id="bg_abc123")

// Cancel if no longer needed
background_cancel(task_id="bg_abc123")
```

### Category-Based Task Delegation

```typescript
// Visual/frontend tasks -> Gemini
task(
  category="visual-engineering",
  prompt="Add a responsive chart component to the dashboard page"
)

// Deep reasoning tasks -> GPT-5.3 Codex
task(
  category="ultrabrain",
  prompt="Design the database schema for a multi-tenant SaaS application"
)

// Quick fixes -> Claude Haiku
task(
  category="quick",
  prompt="Fix the typo in the README and update the version number"
)

// Documentation/prose -> Kimi K2.5
task(
  category="writing",
  prompt="Write API documentation for the user authentication endpoints"
)
```

## Commands

### /init-deep - Generate AGENTS.md Hierarchy

```bash
# Generate hierarchical AGENTS.md files throughout your project
/init-deep

# Create new files only (don't update existing)
/init-deep --create-new

# Limit depth of hierarchy
/init-deep --max-depth=3

# Result structure:
# project/
# ├── AGENTS.md              # Project-wide context
# ├── src/
# │   ├── AGENTS.md          # src-specific context
# │   └── components/
# │       └── AGENTS.md      # Component-specific context
```

### /ralph-loop - Continuous Development Loop

```bash
# Start self-referential loop until task completion
/ralph-loop "Build a REST API with authentication"

# With iteration limit
/ralph-loop "Refactor the payment module" --max-iterations=50

# Cancel active loop
/cancel-ralph

# Ultrawork variant (maximum intensity)
/ulw-loop "Implement the entire checkout flow"
```

### /refactor - Intelligent Refactoring

```bash
# Basic refactoring
/refactor UserService

# Specify scope
/refactor AuthModule --scope=module

# Aggressive strategy
/refactor PaymentController --strategy=aggressive

# Features include:
# - LSP-powered rename and navigation
# - AST-grep for pattern matching
# - Architecture analysis before changes
# - TDD verification after changes
```

### /start-work and /handoff

```bash
# Execute Prometheus-generated plan
/start-work

# Execute specific named plan
/start-work authentication-refactor

# Create handoff document for session continuation
/handoff

# Stop all continuation mechanisms
/stop-continuation
```

## Tools

### LSP Tools - IDE Features for Agents

```typescript
// Get errors/warnings before build
lsp_diagnostics(file_path="src/api/users.ts")

// Validate rename operation
lsp_prepare_rename(
  file_path="src/services/UserService.ts",
  line=15,
  character=10
)

// Rename symbol across entire workspace
lsp_rename(
  file_path="src/services/UserService.ts",
  line=15,
  character=10,
  new_name="CustomerService"
)

// Jump to symbol definition
lsp_goto_definition(
  file_path="src/controllers/auth.ts",
  line=42,
  character=15
)

// Find all usages across workspace
lsp_find_references(
  file_path="src/utils/validators.ts",
  line=8,
  character=20
)

// Get file outline or search workspace symbols
lsp_symbols(file_path="src/models/User.ts")
lsp_symbols(query="handleAuth")
```

### AST-Grep Tools - Pattern-Based Code Search/Replace

```typescript
// Search for patterns across 25 languages
ast_grep_search(
  pattern="console.log($$$)",
  lang="typescript",
  path="src/"
)
// Returns all console.log statements with any arguments

// Find React components with specific props
ast_grep_search(
  pattern="<Button onClick={$_} disabled />",
  lang="tsx",
  path="src/components/"
)

// Replace patterns across codebase
ast_grep_replace(
  pattern="console.log($MSG)",
  replacement="logger.debug($MSG)",
  lang="typescript",
  path="src/"
)

// Find async functions without try-catch
ast_grep_search(
  pattern="async function $NAME($$$) { $$$BODY }",
  lang="javascript"
)
```

### Session Tools

```typescript
// List all OpenCode sessions
session_list()

// Read messages from a specific session
session_read(session_id="sess_abc123", limit=50)

// Full-text search across all sessions
session_search(query="authentication bug", limit=20)

// Get session metadata and statistics
session_info(session_id="sess_abc123")
```

### Task Management Tools

Requires `experimental.task_system: true` in config.

```typescript
// Create a new task
task_create({
  subject: "Build frontend components",
  description: "Create React components for the dashboard",
  status: "pending"
})
// Returns: T-001

// Create dependent tasks
task_create({
  subject: "Run integration tests",
  description: "Execute full test suite",
  blockedBy: ["T-001", "T-002"]
})
// T-003 waits until T-001 and T-002 complete

// List all tasks
task_list()
// T-001 [pending] Build frontend        blockedBy: []
// T-002 [pending] Build backend         blockedBy: []
// T-003 [pending] Integration tests     blockedBy: [T-001, T-002]

// Update task status
task_update({ id: "T-001", status: "completed" })

// Get specific task
task_get({ id: "T-001" })
```

### Interactive Terminal (Tmux)

```typescript
// Create a new tmux session
interactive_bash(tmux_command="new-session -d -s dev-app")

// Send keystrokes to session
interactive_bash(tmux_command="send-keys -t dev-app 'vim main.py' Enter")

// Run command in session
interactive_bash(tmux_command="send-keys -t dev-app 'pytest tests/' Enter")

// Capture pane output
interactive_bash(tmux_command="capture-pane -p -t dev-app")

// Split pane for multiple views
interactive_bash(tmux_command="split-window -h -t dev-app")

// Kill session when done
interactive_bash(tmux_command="kill-session -t dev-app")
```

## Skills

### Using Built-in Skills

```bash
# Git Master - atomic commits, rebase, history analysis
/git-master commit these changes
/git-master rebase onto main
/git-master who wrote this authentication code?

# Playwright - browser automation
/playwright Navigate to https://example.com and take a screenshot
/playwright Fill the login form and submit

# Frontend UI/UX - design-first development
/frontend-ui-ux Create a modern dashboard layout with dark mode support
```

### Task Delegation with Skills

```typescript
// The Designer: UI implementation with browser verification
task(
  category="visual-engineering",
  load_skills=["frontend-ui-ux", "playwright"],
  prompt="Implement the checkout page design and verify rendering in browser"
)

// The Architect: pure reasoning for system design
task(
  category="ultrabrain",
  load_skills=[],
  prompt="Design the microservices architecture for the payment system"
)

// The Maintainer: quick fixes with clean commits
task(
  category="quick",
  load_skills=["git-master"],
  prompt="Fix the validation bug and create an atomic commit"
)
```

### Creating Custom Skills

Create `.opencode/skills/my-skill/SKILL.md`:

```markdown
---
name: api-tester
description: API testing and validation skill
mcp:
  httpie:
    command: npx
    args: ["-y", "@anthropic-ai/mcp-httpie"]
---

# API Testing Skill

You are an API testing specialist. When testing endpoints:

1. Always verify response status codes
2. Validate response schemas
3. Test edge cases and error conditions
4. Document expected vs actual behavior

## Available Tools

Use the httpie MCP for making HTTP requests with proper authentication.
```

## MCPs (Model Context Protocol)

### Built-in MCPs

```typescript
// Web search via Exa AI
websearch_web_search_exa(query="best practices for JWT authentication")

// Library documentation via Context7
context7_get_library_docs(library="express", topic="middleware")

// GitHub code search via grep.app
grep_app_search(query="rate limiter implementation", language="typescript")
```

### Skill-Embedded MCPs with OAuth

```yaml
# In SKILL.md frontmatter
---
description: GitHub API skill
mcp:
  github:
    url: https://api.github.com/mcp
    oauth:
      clientId: ${GITHUB_CLIENT_ID}
      scopes: ["repo", "read:user"]
---
```

```bash
# Pre-authenticate via CLI
bunx oh-my-opencode mcp oauth login github --server-url https://api.github.com

# OAuth features:
# - Auto-discovery via .well-known endpoints
# - PKCE mandatory for all flows
# - Token storage in ~/.config/opencode/mcp-oauth.json
# - Auto-refresh on 401 responses
```

## Hooks

### Disabling Hooks

```jsonc
{
  "disabled_hooks": [
    "comment-checker",        // Disable comment quality checking
    "auto-update-checker",    // Disable update notifications
    "agent-usage-reminder",   // Disable agent usage reminders
    "startup-toast"           // Disable startup toast only
  ]
}
```

### Claude Code Hooks Integration

Configure in `~/.claude/settings.json` or `.claude/settings.json`:

```json
{
  "hooks": {
    "PostToolUse": [
      {
        "matcher": "Write|Edit",
        "hooks": [
          { "type": "command", "command": "eslint --fix $FILE" },
          { "type": "command", "command": "prettier --write $FILE" }
        ]
      }
    ],
    "PreToolUse": [
      {
        "matcher": "Bash",
        "hooks": [
          { "type": "command", "command": "echo 'Running: $COMMAND'" }
        ]
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Tmux Integration

### Enable Visual Multi-Agent

```jsonc
{
  "tmux": {
    "enabled": true,
    "layout": "main-vertical",
    "main_pane_size": 60,
    "main_pane_min_width": 120,
    "agent_pane_min_width": 40
  }
}
```

```bash
# Start OpenCode with port for tmux integration
opencode --port 3000

# Background agents now spawn in separate tmux panes:
# - Watch multiple agents work in real-time
# - Each pane shows agent output live
# - Auto-cleanup when agents complete
```

## LSP Configuration

### Custom Language Server Setup

```jsonc
{
  "lsp": {
    "typescript-language-server": {
      "command": ["typescript-language-server", "--stdio"],
      "extensions": [".ts", ".tsx"],
      "priority": 10,
      "env": { "NODE_OPTIONS": "--max-old-space-size=4096" },
      "initialization": {
        "preferences": { "includeInlayParameterNameHints": "all" }
      }
    },
    "pylsp": {
      "command": ["pylsp"],
      "extensions": [".py"],
      "priority": 5
    },
    "rust-analyzer": {
      "command": ["rust-analyzer"],
      "extensions": [".rs"],
      "initialization": {
        "cargo": { "allFeatures": true }
      }
    },
    "gopls": { "disabled": true }
  }
}
```

## Uninstallation

### Remove Oh My OpenCode

```bash
# Remove plugin from OpenCode config
jq '.plugin = [.plugin[] | select(. != "oh-my-opencode")]' \
    ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json > /tmp/oc.json && \
    mv /tmp/oc.json ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json

# Remove configuration files
rm -f ~/.config/opencode/oh-my-opencode.json
rm -f ~/.config/opencode/oh-my-opencode.jsonc
rm -f .opencode/oh-my-opencode.json
rm -f .opencode/oh-my-opencode.jsonc

# Verify removal
opencode --version
```

## Summary

Oh My OpenCode is designed for developers who want to leverage multiple AI models without manual orchestration overhead. The primary use cases include complex multi-file refactoring where LSP and AST tools provide IDE-level precision, parallel development workflows where background agents handle research while you continue implementation, strategic planning for large features using Prometheus interview mode, and continuous development loops that work autonomously until completion. The category system automatically routes tasks to optimal models—Gemini for visual work, GPT for deep reasoning, Haiku for quick fixes.

Integration patterns focus on configuration-driven customization through `oh-my-opencode.jsonc`, skill-based domain expertise that brings specialized MCPs on-demand, and Claude Code compatibility for existing workflows. The plugin works seamlessly with existing OpenCode setups, respecting `.claude/` configurations while adding multi-model orchestration, hash-anchored editing, and discipline enforcement. For teams, the task system with `blockedBy` dependencies enables complex project workflows that persist across sessions, while the handoff command facilitates seamless session continuation.
